name: SUBTLE BODIES
source:
In a civilization wholly birthed amongst the dark, endless ocean between stars: 

The citizens aboard overall dutiful and unassuming — though some are surely more magnificent than others.

[From [url=https://kawaiila.itch.io/subtle-bodies]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个完全诞生于群星之间幽暗无垠星海中的文明里：

船上的公民们大体都恪尽职守、谦逊低调——尽管其中某些人无疑比旁人更加耀眼夺目。

[摘自[url=https://kawaiila.itch.io/subtle-bodies]itch.io[/url]]
